scope: 12 wholly original synthetic English architecture excerpts and 12 predeclared one-document relevance cases. No private source text, benchmark workloads or user data.

documents.title: Outbox publication and idempotent requests
documents.body: A database transaction records the registration and outbox intent. Relay publication can repeat; consumers use event ids for deduplication.

documents.title: Kafka partition key and consumer order
documents.body: Kafka topic partitions order records for a partition key; group reassignment can change consumer ownership. Delivery and offset semantics need explicit tests.

documents.title: Little's Law and offered workload
documents.body: Queueing identity uses average concurrency, throughput and response time in a precisely bounded stable window. Burst arrivals can build wait time.

documents.title: Admission control and load shedding
documents.body: Early admission rejection prevents unbounded queue occupancy when downstream capacity is saturated. Retry amplification and fairness remain risks.

documents.title: Database connection pool saturation
documents.body: Pool acquisition waiting and excessive open connections can degrade database response under concurrency; measure transaction holding time and resource use.

documents.title: PostgreSQL MVCC visibility
documents.body: PostgreSQL multi version concurrency control governs transaction snapshots, row visibility, vacuum and update behavior.

documents.title: Java virtual threads and blocking IO
documents.body: Virtual threads permit many concurrent blocking tasks but do not make database connections unlimited. Carrier pinning depends on exact Java runtime version.

documents.title: Distributed cache invalidation
documents.body: Cache freshness and invalidation races require version tokens, TTL reasoning, ownership and explicit stale read tolerance.

documents.title: Vector index approximate nearest neighbors
documents.body: HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor graph indexing improves vector candidate retrieval, with recall and memory tradeoffs beyond lexical matching.

documents.title: Distributed trace propagation and spans
documents.body: Trace context propagation connects spans across services, enabling diagnosis of dependency latency and partial failures.

documents.title: HTTP request idempotent methods
documents.body: HTTP PUT and DELETE have defined idempotent intent, distinct from exactly once business effects across external systems.

documents.title: Monolith modernization and transition
documents.body: Legacy modular monolith modernization may use branch by abstraction, strangler and expand migrate contract phases with compatibility gates.
